## Twill v{{VERSION}}

Twill is a Swift library for terminal user interfaces on macOS and Linux.

### Swift Package Manager

Add the package dependency:

```swift
.package(url: "https://github.com/{{REPOSITORY}}.git", from: "{{VERSION}}")
```

Then add the `Twill` library product to your target dependencies.

This is a source release. No standalone CLI binaries, installers, or checksums are published. Example executables are development tools, not release artifacts.

See the [README](https://github.com/{{REPOSITORY}}/blob/v{{VERSION}}/README.md) for usage and project status.
